summary:
寶僑公佈最新季度財報，每股盈餘與營收均優於市場預期，展現穩健的必需消費品定價能力。
• 每股盈餘達 1.43 美元，優於市場預期的 1.41 美元。
• 營收達 212 億美元，年增 1.51%。
• 受惠於核心產品組合優化與成本控制，毛利率保持穩健。
• 維持穩定的現金流分發，展現股東回報承諾。
ai_view:
觀點：財報數據顯示必需消費品需求具備韌性。短中期來看，穩健的獲利有助於支撐防禦型股票的估值，惟需持續追蹤銷量變化、投入成本通膨以及定價策略對市佔率的影響。

需留意：全球消費者對於民生用品的價格敏感度增加，可能壓抑銷量增長。；原物料與供應鏈成本波動可能對利潤率造成潛在壓力。

summary_en:
Procter & Gamble reported quarterly earnings and revenue that beat consensus estimates, demonstrating resilient pricing power in consumer staples.
• EPS of $1.43 beat the consensus estimate of $1.41.
• Revenue reached $21.20 billion, representing a 1.51% year-over-year increase.
• Gross margins remained resilient supported by core product mix optimization and cost discipline.
• Maintained consistent cash flow distribution, demonstrating commitment to shareholder returns.

ai_view_en:
View: Earnings results indicate resilient demand in consumer staples. In the near to medium term, solid profitability supports defensive valuations, though investors should continue to track unit volume trends, input cost inflation, and pricing impacts on market share.

Watch：Increased consumer price sensitivity on household goods could constrain volume growth.; Volatility in raw material and supply chain costs may exert potential pressure on margins.
